Container.Name: PrintGuard
Container.Overview:
PrintGuard is a real-time 3D print failure detection system powered by computer vision. It monitors your printer-facing cameras and automatically pauses or cancels print jobs when failures (e.g. spaghetti, layer shifts, detached prints) are detected. Manage multiple printers and cameras through its built-in web dashboard and receive desktop or mobile push notifications. Integrates with OctoPrint.
On first run, visit http://[IP]:[PORT]/setup to complete the initial configuration wizard (SSL certificates, VAPID keys for push notifications, camera feeds, and OctoPrint integration).
NOTE: Privileged mode is required for USB/local camera device access. If you are using RTSP streams exclusively you may be able to disable it.
Container.Requires: OctoPrint (optional) — required only if you want to integrate print job control

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the PrintGuard web interface and setup wizard.

Config.Name: Appdata Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for PrintGuard configuration, SSL certificates, VAPID keys, and cache. Back this directory up to preserve your setup.
